title: Deeper/broader open-source comparator route applicability and operation-specific coverage
mode: Primary project documentation/source and issue review; research-only plan refinement
scope: Compare route-specific behavior and coverage claims across ACadSharp, FreeCAD, GDAL, ezdxf, LibreDWG, and Open CASCADE.
Distinguish structured codec read/write, conversion, recovery, XREF import, OGR projection, native acceptance, and geometry semantics.
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 composed comparator manifest without changing local implementation or routine validation cadence.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project documentation, source, and issue pages
method.limitations: Documentation and issue pages may describe mutable repositories or a specific reported build. No external route was executed, so this pass refines evidence admission and implementation readiness rather than qualifying peer behavior or proving a new local defect.

sources.observed: The project publishes separate DXF-reader, DXF-writer, DWG-reader, and DWG-writer version columns. Issue #1131 reports a specific custom-object path where unknown-entity notifications did not correspond to final document membership.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Mutable capability declaration and a peer-specific issue report; not a pinned artifact run or evidence of a libdxfrw defect.

sources.observed: Stock DWG handling uses an external converter to create DXF, then a selected C++ or legacy Python importer. The documented importer entity lists differ: the legacy route lists 3DFACE; the C++ route omits it and skips text, dimensions, and attributes in blocks. Documentation says stock importers do not read embedded ACIS/SAT solids.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Current documentation of intended consumer workflow and limits; not a native platform run or a libdxfrw support qualification.

sources.observed: The DXF route is an OGR projection with documented unsupported entities and missing 3D/OCS behavior for some annotations, plus styling and geometry limitations.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Projection behavior only; not a structural round-trip, general DXF implementation, native CAD, or spline semantic oracle.

sources.observed: The project documents structured DXF read/write and third-party data retention; its XREF import is a deliberately smaller copyable/transformable subset, and its recovery route repairs structurally flawed inputs while preserving separate audit diagnostics.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Operation-specific documentation; XREF import and recovery results cannot substitute for strict read/write retention evidence.

sources.observed: The README declares a version-limited DWG writer. Issue #1411 reports that one LibreDWG 0.14.8593 build retained modern solid entity shells while losing R2013+ AcDs SAB payload on a generated input and a private drawing.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A version-specific README claim and a report for one build; not a universal statement about current LibreDWG or a local libdxfrw defect.

sources.observed: Current project materials distinguish standard open-source OCCT formats from separately sold ACIS SAT/SAB and DXF exchange components.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Product/edition documentation; an OCCT-based application cannot be assumed to include a stock open-source ACIS reader.

assessment.planEffect: Add a compact route/applicability manifest at the existing composed checkpoint, including exact artifact and operation, intended/unsupported families, observed dispositions, provenance, and claim boundary.
